name: Chill Touch

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Melee spell attack; Necrotic damage and source-owned healing prevention through end of caster next turn; character-level scaling.

rules.text: Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach.
On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Necrotic damage, and it can’t regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn.
The damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

definition.description: Channeling the chill of the grave, make a melee spell attack against a target within reach.
